sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Unique Experience is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Soldier! I've got a new job that's right up your alley.I've come across something interesting. A new piece of weaponry. Nobody in Tarkov has seen anything like it before! How'd I get it? Trade secret.But I'll tell you this: the weapon definitely has potential. Still, you know as well as I do that all those specs and proving-ground reports don't mean shit until the thing gets tested in the field.So if you're interested in getting your hands on a truly unique weapon, we can help each other out. We'll sort out the payment. I won't leave you hanging."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate any 30 targets with an Aklys Defense Velociraptor on Lighthouse or The Lab

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +65,000 EXP
- Prapor Rep +1.5
- 400,000 Roubles
  - 420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Kalashnikov AK-12 5.45x39 assault rifle
- Unlocks purchase for Kalashnikov AK-12 5.45x39 assault rifle at Prapor LL4
- 1× 5.45x39mm BP gs ammo pack (120 pcs)
- Unlocks craft for 5.45x39mm BP gs at Workbench level 3
- +4 Light Machine Guns skill levels
- +4 Heavy Machine Guns skill levels

"So, it's good, you say? Well then, maybe I can raise the price a little, what do you think?"
